notes: Mass: the weighed subassembly total of the sheet (Avionics). CG: the x of the position sheet, y = 0 and z = 0 are stand-ins.

point_masses.source: 1st Airframe: Avionics weighed total (row 64) less the mapped parts. Itemised in the rest: Servo, PDB + bms + mnt, Cube + herelink + here4 + wires + mnts. Not weighed: none. x: mass-weighted mean of stand-in: the x of Fuselage (the position sheet has no Avionics rows). y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in)
